name: Ikebana Kyoshitsu
description: A pastel, botanical theme for flower schools and ikebana studios, laid out like an arrangement: every page follows the asymmetric triangle of shin, soe and hikae, with off-axis titles, cards that climb a diagonal, images placed high and low around empty space and brush lines that draw themselves in, plus classes and levels, a weekly timetable with a trial-lesson booking form and the teachers, in washi white, sakura pink and stem green with sumi ink and one beni-rouge accent.
